children: The new five-year term took effect from 1 July 2026, extending Agarwal’s tenure at the helm of Century Plyboards and maintaining continuity in its leadership

Century Plyboards has re-appointed Sanjay Agarwal as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director for another five-year term, effective from 1 July 2026. The decision extends his tenure at the top of the company and keeps the existing leadership structure in place as the business continues with its ongoing operational and strategic priorities.

Agarwal’s renewed term commenced on 1 July 2026 and will continue for five years. He will remain responsible for leading the organisation in the dual role of Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director.

The re-appointment means Century Plyboards will continue under Agarwal’s leadership rather than move to a new chief executive during the period. His mandate will remain centred on the company’s overall management, business direction and execution of strategic initiatives.

The extension provides continuity at the senior-most executive level. Agarwal has already been serving as CEO and Managing Director, and the fresh term formalises his continuation in the role for another five years.

For the company, the decision maintains consistency in executive oversight as it continues with its existing business and strategic priorities. Agarwal will continue to work with the broader leadership team while overseeing the organisation’s direction.

As CEO and Managing Director, Agarwal will continue to oversee the company’s day-to-day leadership as well as its broader strategic agenda. His responsibilities include guiding business priorities and maintaining continuity in the execution of management decisions.
The renewed tenure does not mark a change in designation or leadership structure. Instead, it extends the existing arrangement, with Agarwal continuing in both positions under the new five-year term.

The new tenure took effect from 1 July 2026 following the company’s approval of the re-appointment. Agarwal will therefore remain at the helm of Century Plyboards through the renewed term, maintaining continuity in executive leadership and oversight.
With the re-appointment, Century Plyboards has chosen to retain its incumbent CEO and Managing Director for another five-year period, keeping its existing top management structure in place.
